The fast suite is just a pytest marker filter, so you can run it directly:

```sh
python -m pytest -m "not postgres and not integration" -q
```

That skips the Postgres and network integration tests. `just test` runs everything, which needs `docker compose up db` first.

One thing doesn't match what you said: this checkout (`main`, clean) still has the `Makefile` and has no `justfile`. Maybe the switch hasn't been merged or pulled here yet. Once your `justfile` is in place, this recipe would match the old `make test-fast`:

```just
test-fast:
    python -m pytest -m "not postgres and not integration" -q
```

Then you'd run `just test-fast`. If your `justfile` already has a fast-test recipe under a different name, `just --list` will show it.

I haven't changed the stored project note that says to use `make test-fast`, because this repo still matches it. Once the `justfile` lands, I can update the note to point to `just`.
